headline: Deadlands Reopens as Coastal Fronts Fall Quiet
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Deadlands has become the clearest immediate base-fighting front: three strategic-base events were logged in the latest two hours, eight in six hours, and 17 across the day. Its 11 bases remain split, seven Warden and four Colonial, while enlistments are accelerating despite the latest casualty rates cooling. Drowned Vale, formerly the busiest recent theatre, has recorded no fresh event in two hours, though 31 movements in 24 hours leave its 12 bases entirely Colonial at present. Endless Shore likewise shows no two-hour movement, but remains the day’s busiest ledger with 42 events and a nine-to-one Colonial majority. Farranac Coast has 18 daily events and sharply rising one-hour casualty rates, though its latest base event is older. Marban Hollow is now registering accelerating casualties on both sides, with 13 daily base events and a six-to-two Colonial lead. Stlican Shelf also shows accelerating one-hour losses and 13 daily events, while quieter regions report little sign of imminent base turnover.
